_comment: Answer-stage fallback for when the model is unreachable. Each entry carries a canned answer drawn strictly from Extension Bulletin 14, so the verify stage still has something grounded to check. This is NOT a model response and is labelled as such in the Background_View and the disclosure bar. See docs/validation-log.md V-12: an organisation SCP denies bedrock:InvokeModel in this account, so the answer stage cannot run live.

answers.text: The Kangema and Kiriaini collection points are open from 06:00 to 10:00, on Tuesdays and Fridays only. Please bring your member number to the gate.
Payment for delivered produce is released fourteen days after grading is complete. Grading results are posted at the collection point.
Scout your fields twice weekly from the fourth week after emergence. Remove and bury any volunteer plants between the rows.
Certified seed issued from the co-operative store is already treated before you collect it.

default: I can help with collection days, payment cycles, and growing guidance from our extension bulletins. Could you tell me a little more about what you need?
